import 'tables.dart';

/// Another library of the package: a public constant in a `case`, and in a
/// constant.
const usersLimits = [publicLimit, publicLimit + 1];

String named(int value) {
  switch (value) {
    case publicLimit:
      return 'limit';
    default:
      return 'no ${publicTable.length}';
  }
}
